> i thought it was both simultaneously:
>
> Draught of the Soul [BL]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier/Combat
> Discipline: Auspex & Quietus
> Only usable when this acting vampire burns another vampire.

[snip]

> and if it is both simultaneously, then it falls under the one action
> modifier card by name per minion per action, doesn't it?

I don't think there are still any cards that are "both simultaneously"
in any strict sense. You may be remembering how Ritual of the Bitter
Rose used to work (under VTES text it was both an action modifier and
a combat card and so could only be played in combat when acting), or
something.

Nowadays, cards generally have symbols for each type they're playable
as (see Swallowed by the Night, Burning Touch) but don't generally
have text reminding you that they can be played as any of those types,
as appropriate, depending on the text. (Burning Touch for example
lacks such text. Any pre-CE Swallowed by the Night card probably has
it. ("This card may be used as an action modifier card or a combat
card.")

And nowadays, if they *are* only playable under certain circumstances
as certain types, (like, if played as a combat card, may only be played
when acting) they generally get text to that effect (as with the first
line on Draught of the Soul).

Josh
